name: PF Mock Booking
description: Creates fake Calendly bookings (host Aniol, participants aniol.moner+pN) through PF Calendly Capture. Manual only. DWN-6.

parameters.content:
## PF Mock Booking
Makes fake Calendly bookings with Aniol as host and sends them through **PF Calendly Capture**, the same path a real booking takes.

Edit the `bookings` list in **Mock Booking Settings**, then run. Default: one session that starts in 2 min and lasts 3 min.
